titles.romaji: Stand My Heroes: PIECE OF TRUTH
titles.english: Stand My Heroes: Piece of Truth
titles.native: スタンドマイヒーローズ PIECE OF TRUTH

description:
Based on the mobile game of the same name.

As a new agent for STAND, Rei Izumi scouts for the most qualified of investigators to create dedicated teams of heroes. Their assignment is to shield the citizens of Tokyo from the dangerous drugs that are now flooding its streets.

(Source: Amazon)
